report.narrative_markdown:
## Company overview

Joint Stock Company Kaspi.kz provides payments, marketplace and fintech solutions for consumers and merchants in Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan and Ukraine. It reports through three segments: Payments, Marketplace and Fintech. The Payments segment runs a platform that lets consumers pay for shopping and household bills and make peer to peer payments, while merchants can accept payments online and in store. The company is classified in the Technology sector under Software - Infrastructure and trades on NasdaqGS as KSPI, with a market capitalisation of $17.67B.

## Financial commentary

Revenue grew in each reported year, from KZT 1.25T in 2022 to KZT 1.89T in 2023, KZT 2.52T in 2024 and KZT 4.03T in 2025. Net income rose from KZT 585.03B in 2022 to KZT 841.35B in 2023, KZT 1.04T in 2024 and KZT 1.07T in 2025. Net income therefore advanced far more slowly than revenue in the latest year.

The net margin is 24.2% and return on equity is 44.8%. The latest revenue growth figure is 13.6%. Debt/Equity is 0.22, and the dividend yield is 6.2%. The share price is $92.99, within a 52-week range of $68.59 to $109.94.
